Meta Ad Creative

Creative tests built for paid social

Meta ad concepts built around audience-specific hooks, visual angles and offer framing. Concept, copy, design and ad creation were handled by me.

Relatable Hook
Breed-specific owner humour

Uses a highly specific bulldog insight to stop the scroll and qualify the audience before the product pitch.

Offer Framing
Bundle threshold creative

Pairs a breed-led design with a clear multi-buy incentive to increase cart size and make the offer visible fast.

Cold Traffic
Bold persona callout

Leans into identity-driven copy so the ad feels made for one specific pet-owner segment.

Social Proof
Customer-photo validation

Shows the shirt in the wild and turns a review into proof that the product gets real-world attention.

Promo Push
Urgency plus variety

Combines discount, shipping threshold and colour range into one direct-response Cyber Week message.

Comparison Angle
Zoolio versus big brands

Positions the brand against mass-produced alternatives with a simple side-by-side value argument.
